conclusion: Original installer completed in a clean VM, but post-reboot boot acceptance failed. The revised guard correctly stopped on a second clean VM before system mutation.

test_resource_controls.guest_cache_reclamation: Test-only bounded loop: up to 220 iterations, every 8 seconds, sync and drop guest caches when Cached+SReclaimable exceeds 1GiB. This reduces duplicate caching with tmpfs-backed virtual disk; it invalidates performance claims.

fixed_guard.snapshot_method: Sorted JSON of regular-file SHA-256 values and symlink targets, plus runtime/store presence; captured after prerequisite prep and before/after fixed setup. File access times are excluded.

limits: VM installer plumbing and negative boot/guard validation only; this cloud image is not the native Ubuntu Desktop buyer environment.
No Strix Halo BIOS, physical GPU, GPU-targeted installer archive, GPU offload, inference, answer quality, WebUI or hardware reboot qualification.
The fixed script did not complete a fresh full installation: it correctly stopped at the cloud GRUB fragment.
The 0.31.2 default remains within known advisory ranges; this test is not a fully patched runtime endorsement.
This model identity and 0.31.2 runtime are separate from the earlier 0.32.15 GPU probe; neither result completes the other.
host_change_boundary: Only new disposable user-owned VM files and a transient user-scoped resource unit were created. No host sudo, package update, persistent service, routing, firewall or reboot changes. Test guests were powered off.
